Samplebay unit restart planned

Samplebay Refinery plans to restart its hydrocracker next week after maintenance, a company source said. The page states no publication date anywhere. The hydrocracker was taken offline for planned work earlier this month. The operator expects the unit to be back online within days and to reach normal rates soon after. Traders said the restart had been expected and that it had little effect on regional product balances. A further statement is due from the owner at the end of the week, and the site has no other units under maintenance at present.
